name: Garan Electronics & Manufacturers
description: Garan Electronics was founded in 1957 and recently celebrated 65 years as a leader in our chosen field. We are a USA-based small manufacturer of plastic components that produces parts that are utilized in a wide variety of industries ranging from mechanical operations to power supply manufacturers, medical equipment, aerospace, and military products. We manufacture bobbins, shells, terminal boards, cases, and other additional parts. Our products are all custom-made to our customer’s specifications, we utilize a broad range of raw materials to meet our customer’s demands. We pride ourselves on a reasonable cost structure, quick turnaround service, and quality products which have clearly stood the test of time.
